archetype: L-plan civic police precinct with secure detention and motor pool
ground_program: canopied public vestibule, waiting, report counter and victim interview
patrol ready room, lockers and controlled armory issue
booking and processing corridor serving four individual detention cells
rear staff exit and enclosed vehicle sally port
three-lane patrol garage with workshop and vehicle-evidence storage
upper_program: evidence archive, locker/break and training rooms over the secure wing
partial third-floor chief and emergency-operations suite
main stair reaching all occupied floors and independent secure stair to the first floor
circulation: public access is separated from patrol and detention by controlled doors
booking spine reaches all four cells without crossing the public lobby
evidence rooms connect to both booking and upper secure support
sally port connects booking, rear gate and garage
motor pool connects to patrol operations through a separate personnel door
two independent stairs serve the principal occupied floors
damage_constraints: concentrate blast failure in the northwest public/interview facade
remove each affected wall/floor row continuously from the exterior inward
shape a low gravity-led rubble fan across the northwest apron
preserve the public vestibule, both stairs, booking, cells, evidence and garage
retain navigable survivor routes on all three occupied levels
derive damage, occupation and loot only from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the complex reads as a precinct rather than a generic office cube
public, patrol, detention, evidence and garage security relationships work at player scale
all 51 declared thresholds and both stairs work in game
all four cells, sally port and three vehicle lanes remain usable
the northwest breach terminates slabs coherently and its rubble follows gravity
terrain feathering seats the road apron, rear gate and rubble into city grade
